title: Zoom in: every partition has one leader, and the controller moves it
caption: Spreading leaders spreads the writes; a failover promotes an in-sync follower, and a returning broker catches up before it leads again.

steps.text: The orders topic has 3 partitions with 3 replicas each. The controller spreads the leaders, so each broker leads one partition and follows the other two.
Producers read the leader map from metadata and send each partition's batch straight to its leader: writes spread across all brokers.
Followers fetch from the leader. For p0, brokers 2 and 3 copy from broker 1; while they keep up they are in the in-sync replica set (ISR).
With acks=all and min.insync.replicas=2, broker 1 acknowledges a batch once the ISR has it. Consumers only see records up to that point.

scenarios.name: Broker 1 dies
scenarios.summary: An in-sync follower takes over in seconds and nothing acknowledged is lost, but one broker now carries two partitions' writes.

steps.text: Broker 1 loses power. Its p0 leadership and its follower copies of p1 and p2 are gone.
The controller notices the missed heartbeats within seconds and makes broker 2, which is in p0's ISR, the new leader with a higher leader epoch.
Producers get NOT_LEADER, refresh metadata and retry p0 on broker 2. Everything that was acknowledged was already on broker 2, so no record is lost.
Broker 3 now follows broker 2 for p0. The ISR is {2, 3}, still enough for min.insync.replicas=2, but broker 2 takes double the writes.

scenarios.name: Broker 1 returns
scenarios.summary: A returning broker first catches up as a follower; only then does the controller move its preferred leadership back.

steps.text: Broker 1 restarts with a stale copy of p0. It doesn't serve anything yet.
It fetches the records it missed from broker 2, the current leader, and rejoins p0's ISR once it is caught up.
Preferred-leader election moves p0 back to broker 1, so each broker leads one partition again.
Producers follow the new metadata. Load is balanced again; without this step broker 2 would stay the hot spot.

scenarios.name: Risk: unclean election
scenarios.summary: If every in-sync replica is gone, you choose between an offline partition and losing acknowledged records. Kafka's default is offline.

steps.text: Broker 3 had fallen behind and was dropped from p0's ISR. Then brokers 1 and 2 die together.
unclean.leader.election.enable=false (the default): p0 stays offline until broker 1 or 2 comes back. Producers to p0 fail; no data is lost.
Set it to true and broker 3 becomes the leader: p0 is available again, but every record it hadn't copied is gone. Choose per topic: payments never, metrics maybe.
